  input              sys_clk,

  output             ddr3_reset_n,

  output             ddr3_cas_n,
  output             ddr3_we_n,
  inout   [31:0]     ddr3_dq,
  inout   [3:0]      ddr3_dqs_p,
  inout   [3:0]      ddr3_dqs_n,
  output  [3:0]      ddr3_dm,
  output             ddr3_odt,
  input              ddr3_rzq,
  output             eth1_tx_clk,
  output             eth1_tx_ctl,
  output  [3:0]      eth1_tx_d,
  input              eth1_rx_clk,
  input              eth1_rx_ctl,
  input   [3:0]      eth1_rx_d,
  output             eth1_mdc,
  inout              eth1_mdio,
  inout              link_st,
  inout              rx_er,
  inout              phy_int,
  inout              eth_rst,
  inout              phy_led1,
  output             qspi_ss0,
  output             qspi_clk,
  inout   [3:0]      qspi_io,
  output             sdio_clk,
  inout              sdio_cmd,
  inout   [3:0]      sdio_d,
  input              usb1_clk,
  output             usb1_stp,
  input              usb1_dir,
  input              usb1_nxt,
  inout   [7:0]      usb1_d,
  inout              usb1_rst,
  input              uart0_rx,
  output             uart0_tx,
  inout              hps_scl,
  inout              hps_sda,
  output             hdmi_clk,
  output  reg        hdmi_de,
  output  reg        hdmi_hsync,
  output  reg        hdmi_vsync,
  output  [23:0]     hdmi_data,
  output             hdmi_spdif,
  input              hdmi_spdifout,
  input              hdmi_int,
  output             ct_hpd,
  output             ls_oe,
  output             cec_clk,
  inout              fmc_scl,
  inout              fmc_sda,
  inout              fmc_pg_c2m,
  inout              fmc_prsnt_m2c,
  inout              cpu_gpio_0,
  inout              cpu_gpio_1,
  inout              led_hps_1,
  inout              led_hps_2,

  inout              alert_n,
  inout              user_btn_hps,
  inout              status,
  inout              as_rst,
  inout              qspi_rst
);

  wire sys_resetn;

  assign ct_hpd = 1'b1;
  assign ls_oe = 1'b1;  
  assign cec_clk = 1'b0;

  wire [7:0] hdmi_red_i;
  wire [7:0] hdmi_grn_i; 
  wire [7:0] hdmi_blu_i;  

  // ddr12 functionality embedded below:
  reg [11:0] ddr12_dataout;
  always @(posedge hdmi_clk) begin
    ddr12_dataout <= {hdmi_red_i[7:4], hdmi_blu_i[3:0], hdmi_grn_i[7:4], hdmi_grn_i[3:0], hdmi_blu_i[7:4], hdmi_red_i[3:0]};
  end

  assign hdmi_data[11:0] = ddr12_dataout;
  assign hdmi_data[23:12] = 12'b0;

  // system_bd functionality embedded below:
  assign hdmi_red_i = {24{1'b0}};
  assign hdmi_grn_i = {24{1'b0}};
  assign hdmi_blu_i = {24{1'b0}};
  always @(posedge sys_clk) begin
    if (sys_resetn == 1'b0) begin
      hdmi_de <= 1'b0;
      hdmi_hsync <= 1'b0;
      hdmi_vsync <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      hdmi_de <= !hdmi_de;
      hdmi_hsync <= !hdmi_hsync;
      hdmi_vsync <= !hdmi_vsync;
    end
  end

  // Internal assignments for unconnected signals
  assign sys_resetn = 1'b1; // Adjust to actual reset logic

endmodule
